item.title: Boulder bike shop was sold without owner’s OK, he says
item.description: The merger of two Boulder bicycle stores in 2021 and their subsequent sale to Mike’s Bikes last year could all be unspooled by a judge after the owner of one of the merged stores has come forward claiming his shop was stolen from him and sold off without his permission.
